title: Executive Briefing: Navigating Raw Material Volatility in Specialty Chemicals
summary: A recording of our live analytical session evaluating price benchmarking and supplier dependency in polymer intermediates.
body: During this 50-minute executive session, Chromatus research directors break down price transmission mechanisms, upstream crude dependencies, and customer willingness-to-absorb margin surcharges.
author: Chromatus Chemicals Practice

title: Chromatus Expands On-Ground Field Network to 60+ Districts Across India
summary: Strengthening primary data collection infrastructure with dedicated bilingual field investigators and mobile CAPI validation units.
body: Chromatus Consulting is pleased to announce the nationwide expansion of its dedicated primary investigation network. With over 60 active field officers and supervisors across industrial, rural, and metropolitan regions, Chromatus continues to guarantee high-integrity ground data without third-party outsourcing.
author: Gaurav Bhedasgaonkar
